**Head of People, Anika Desai -** As Head of People, Anika owns recruitment, access provisioning, training and offboarding. She is people-focused and serious about building a least-privilege, security-aware culture. TSR-INC-2025-031 exposed the human side of weak access hygiene: the engineer whose credentials contributed held overly broad, standing access, and joiner-mover-leaver controls - including offboarding revocation (ISMS-PR-014) - did not keep pace. Anika is now tightening access reviews, security awareness and the leavers process the certification audit is scrutinising.

**Interview Focus: Head of People Anika Desai**
Students should examine the people and access dimensions of the breach. Strong lines of questioning: how standing access and a slow leavers process contributed to TSR-INC-2025-031; how effective security awareness training really is; the tension between a collaborative culture and least-privilege enforcement; how access reviews and offboarding revocation are being tightened; and Tessera's workforce readiness for any future AI work, given there is no AI talent today.
